name: AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 (Radeon 8060S Graphics) product specifications page
notes: Vendor primary spec page for the APU that carries the Radeon 8060S iGPU. No publication date printed, so published is null. Verbatim fields used: Name 'AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395', Series 'Ryzen AI Max 300 Series', Form Factor 'Laptops , Desktops', Former Codename Strix Halo, Processor Architecture 16x Zen 5, # of CPU Cores 16, Multithreading Yes, # of Threads 32, Max. Boost Clock Up to 5.1 GHz, Base Clock 3 GHz, L2 Cache 16 MB, L3 Cache 64 MB, Default TDP 55W, AMD Configurable TDP (cTDP) 45-120W, Processor Technology for CPU Cores TSMC 4nm FinFET, Package Die Count 3, PCI Express Version PCIe 4.0, Native PCIe Lanes (Total/Usable) 16/16, System Memory Type '256-bit LPDDR5x', Max. Memory 128 GB, Max Memory Speed LPDDR5x-8000, Graphics Model 'Radeon 8060S Graphics', Graphics Core Count 40, Graphics Frequency 2900 MHz, Max Displays 4, AI Engine Capabilities Overall TOPS 'Up to 126 TOPS', NPU TOPS 'Up to 50 TOPS'. CRITICAL OMISSIONS, which the record states rather than fills: this page publishes NO GPU memory size, NO GPU memory bandwidth, NO GPU board power, and NO GPU compute (TFLOPs/TOPS) figure for the 8060S. GPU capacity is the CPU's shared LPDDR5x pool, capped at 128 GB by the APU, not a fixed VRAM. The 'Overall TOPS Up to 126 TOPS' and 'NPU TOPS Up to 50 TOPS' rows are SYSTEM and NPU figures respectively - neither is a GPU figure, so neither is recorded as a GPU flops row; AMD does not publish the derivation of the 126 TOPS system figure, so it is left out entirely.
